artBrief: **Chibi adventure.** A small learner waves from a path of stepping stones, carrying a bright book-shaped backpack. Each step feels achievable.

request.description: One original collectible achievement illustration for a language-learning app, native 128x128 pixel art, opaque square environmental scene. Crisp deliberate pixel clusters, clean readable silhouettes, restrained 32-color palette. A single strong focal subject should remain identifiable at 64x64. Fill the canvas but keep the main subject within an 8-pixel safe margin. No badge frame, lettering, numbers, readable text, logos or watermarks; no photorealism, blur or smooth vector art. Chibi adventure. A small learner waves from a path of stepping stones, carrying a bright book-shaped backpack. Each step feels achievable. White fox learner with pointed ears and a fluffy tail, waving from a simple path of large stepping stones. Bright blue book-shaped backpack, hopeful grassy spring landscape, clear friendly silhouette.

style_image.usage_description: Copy only pixel cluster scale, crisp edge handling and shading discipline. Do not copy the reference scene, objects, layout or palette. Follow the new scene brief. Where a white fox is requested, preserve its pointed ears, muzzle and fluffy tail.
